frozen_plan.shared_index_matrix: one matrix reused by every arm and comparison

metric_definitions.difference: 逐场景配对后再取均值（同一场景号、同一初始状态、同一世界种子）
metric_definitions.metered_bytes_per_episode: 每集 spent_bytes：按发送尝试计量的空气时长字节/集（丢包不退费，airtime_tap_total == spent_bytes 已在门禁闭合）
metric_definitions.timely_target_set: 该臂账本里 credited 的 task_id 集合
metric_definitions.timely_tasks_per_episode: 每集 on_time（lifecycle 指标，个/集，分母 64 个场景）

quality_rule: 零完成、零发现或零计量的场景是本块的合法结果，一律保留在册并计入分母；只有技术失败（异常、缺记录）才可重跑
reporting_cautions: 区间包含 0 不等于等效
未观察到任务损失不等于 δ=0 的总体保证
单个 seed 成功不代表训练算法稳定
不得挑一个显著结果宣称整体方法成立
sampled 每场景一次不是完整采样不确定性评估
各臂的发送尝试次数不同 ⇒ 逐消息丢包实现也不同，只可声称场景配对
本块 64 个场景是新登记块，但一次终评仍不足以支持部署主张

greedy.note: three training seeds are three fits of the same recipe; agreement in sign is not evidence that the training algorithm is stable, and the seeds are not independent scenario samples

sampled.note: three training seeds are three fits of the same recipe; agreement in sign is not evidence that the training algorithm is stable, and the seeds are not independent scenario samples
